bullets.text: Under supervision, ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided public policy records, then edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Executed and inspected supplied scikit-learn notebook procedures using TF-IDF features and logistic regression for topic classification; examined fixed held-out evaluation using macro F-score and example errors.

Validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks; executed and inspected supplied analysis notebooks to visualize and examine how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
